description: verify_bundle on the category_coverage member: its five properties and the strict verdict (Evidence Bundle -02). See README.md.

cases.description: One category in each of the six statuses, signed by the producer key, with every input supplied: all five properties pass.
The same with no inputs: the set is unknown to the verifier (INCONCLUSIVE), request and consistency are NOT_CHECKED.
A Bundle with no category_coverage member.
A private x- set: never looked up, reported NOT_PRESENT; the request names another set.
No signer and no signature: the declaration is attributed to no one (NOT_PRESENT), which does not fail the Bundle.
Signed by another key than signer.key_id.
Signed over another Bundle's root: a declaration moved from another Bundle.
WITHHELD changed to AVAILABLE after signing.
UNDISCLOSED with no policy_uri.
UNDISCLOSED with a policy_uri that has a fragment.
UNDISCLOSED with a policy_uri holding a non-ASCII character.
UNDISCLOSED with a policy_uri holding %zz.
UNDISCLOSED with a relative policy_uri.
A status in lowercase (available).
A status that is not one of the six (LEGAL_HOLD).
categories is an empty object.
No set.
request_digest in uppercase hex.
signer with no signature.
category_coverage is an array.
A name the registered set does not have: set_registered fails, which is reported and does not fail the Bundle.
A set the verifier does not know: INCONCLUSIVE.
The request asks for payments; the declaration has no entry for it.
request_digest names another request than the one supplied, which asks for the same categories.
The request asked for no categories: NOT_PRESENT.
request_digest names another request, and the supplied octets are not JSON: the digest is checked first.
The request repeats the categories member: it is not read, so the property is NOT_CHECKED.
The caller assigns two of the three records: the third could be in any category, so consistency is NOT_CHECKED.
A carried record is in a category declared ABSENT.
A carried record is in a category declared WITHHELD.
A carried record is in a category declared DELETED: not a contradiction.
A carried record is in a category declared UNDISCLOSED: not a contradiction.
